{
  "subtype": "focus_inference",
  "implied_focus": "The nature and resolution of IT incidents -- characterizing what breaks (device/problem type), how severe/impactful it is, and how it gets resolved.",
  "per_column": [
    {"name": "incident_device_type", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Classifies the affected asset, a core facet of characterizing the incident."},
    {"name": "problem_severity_level", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Captures the failure mode/severity, central to understanding incident nature."},
    {"name": "assigned_technician", "supports_focus": false, "rationale": "Largely duplicates existing assigned_to; an operational actor field, not a facet of the incident-nature focus."},
    {"name": "caller_identity", "supports_focus": false, "rationale": "Duplicates existing caller_id; identity restatement, not a focus facet."},
    {"name": "description_detail_level", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "A meta-attribute of the ticket describing symptom specificity, relevant to characterizing incidents."},
    {"name": "systemic_recurrence", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Recurring vs first-occurrence is a meaningful analytical facet of incident nature."},
    {"name": "assignee_closure_alignment", "supports_focus": false, "rationale": "A process/handoff metric orthogonal to the incident-characterization focus; adds a different concern (workflow integrity)."},
    {"name": "resolution_approach", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "How the incident was resolved, a coherent facet tied to incident type and outcome."},
    {"name": "business_impact_domain", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Impact facet, directly supports prioritizing what's worth analyzing."}
  ],
  "focus_coherence": 0.6,
  "structure_quality": 0.65,
  "focus_actionability": 0.75,
  "rationale": "A clear majority of the added columns (device_type, problem_severity, description_detail_level, systemic_recurrence, resolution_approach, business_impact_domain) cohere around one inferable focus: characterizing IT incidents by their nature, resolution, and impact -- a genuinely useful analytical structure with differentiated facets at good granularity. This is neither a single restatement nor pure noise, and the focus is actionable (an analyst could investigate recurring device failures, high-impact categories, or resolution patterns). However, coherence is diluted by three columns: assigned_technician and caller_identity merely restate existing assigned_to/caller_id (identity fields, not focus facets), and assignee_closure_alignment injects a separate process-integrity concern. This grab-bag element and the redundancy prevent higher marks on coherence and structure."
}
